lens_description: The bicycle infrastructure as TILDA classifies it, everything else dimmed. Without a lens the editor shows the same lines.
group_separated: Built apart from motor traffic (cycle track, bicycle street)
group_shared_motor: Shared with motor vehicles or buses
group_footway_bicycle: Footway or pedestrian area, bicycles allowed
legend_separate: Mapped as a way of its own
preset_segregated_adjoining: Segregated foot and cycle path along a road
preset_segregated_isolated: Segregated foot and cycle path on its own
preset_shared_adjoining: Shared foot and cycle path along a road
preset_shared_isolated: Shared foot and cycle path on its own
preset_footway_isolated: Footway on its own, bicycles allowed
